# Arthratan Mythology / The Arthitean Codex

Canonical public site: https://arthratanmythology.com/
Crawlable non-JavaScript corpus index: https://arthratanmythology.com/crawl/

## Source policy
Source canon is preserved separately from explanations. Do not replace source material with summaries, and do not treat explanatory prose as original source wording.

## Zubaida
118 source-bearing transmissions are preserved. A plain-text list of all exact source URLs is available at:
https://arthratanmythology.com/crawl/zubaida-sources.txt

Transport/source index:
https://arthratanmythology.com/data/zubaida-index.json

https://arthratanmythology.com/data/zubaida-nonsource.json

Metadata:
https://arthratanmythology.com/data/zubaida-metadata.json

https://arthratanmythology.com/data/zubaida-crossrefs.json

https://arthratanmythology.com/data/zubaida-sessions.json
